description: The AR6 Scenarios Database is the ensemble of quantitative mitigation scenarios collected and assessed by IPCC Working Group III for the Sixth Assessment Report, published by the Integrated Assessment Modeling Consortium and IIASA. The Zenodo record read on 2026-09-26 (version 1.1, 9 November 2022) states that it holds 3,131 scenarios from 191 modelling frameworks and more than 95 model families, with data on socio-economic development, greenhouse gas emissions and transformations of energy, land use, transport, buildings and industry, from global to national scale. Scenarios had to be published by 11 October 2021 and are grouped by climate outcome, overshoot, technology and policy categories. Data are downloaded from the AR6 Scenario Explorer hosted by IIASA as separate CSV files for the World, R5, R6 and R10 regions and for countries (ISO3), plus an XLSX of metadata indicators and climate assessment files; uncompressed files range from 3 MB to about 1.3 GB. The Explorer is script-rendered, so its terms were not read; derived Zenodo datasets cite the scenario data as CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the ensemble is not a probability distribution, and variable coverage varies by model. Simulation uses are long-term demand and capacity pathways for energy system and infrastructure planning under mitigation scenarios. Related records: data-iiasa-ssp-scenario-explorer holds the SSP database on the same platform.
